## Changes Made

### 1. Medication Banner on Home Screen (`DashboardView.swift`)
- Added `@AppStorage("lastMedicationDate")` and `@AppStorage("medicationReminderEnabled")` state
- Added `hasTakenMedicationToday` computed property
- Added a `medicationBanner` card that appears when the reminder is set and medication hasn't been logged yet today
- Tapping **"Mark Taken"** logs the medication and earns **+25 DC** instantly

### 2. Text Reminders via Onboarding (`OnboardingContainerView.swift`)
- Added a new `medicationReminder` onboarding step that appears right after the notification permission screen
- `MedicationReminderOnboardingView` lets users pick their daily medication time with a wheel picker
- Tapping **"Set Reminder"** calls `NotificationManager.shared.setMedicationReminderTime()`, which schedules a repeating daily notification at the chosen time
- Has a **"Skip"** button for users without medication

### 3. Medication Notification Scheduling (`NotificationManager.swift`)
- Added `medicationReminderEnabled` and `medicationReminderTimeString` storage
- `scheduleMedicationReminder()` — fires daily at the user's chosen time with "Time to take your medication. Earn 25 DC!"
- `setMedicationReminderTime()` — saves time + enables + schedules
- `toggleMedicationReminder()` — enable/disable toggle
- Integrated into `scheduleInitialNotifications()` so it persists across app restarts

### 4. Easy Points (`DopamineCoinManager.swift`)
- Added `static let medicationTaken = 25` — marking medication daily gives an easy, meaningful reward users will see immediately on the home screen

## Color-Coded "Add Sounds" Page

**Navigation**: Settings → Notifications & Sounds → **Alert Sounds**

### Color scheme per category:
| Category | Color | Header | Badges | Row tint (selected) | Circle button |
|----------|-------|--------|--------|---------------------|---------------|
| **CRITICAL** | Red | Red | Red pill | Red tint bg | Red stroke/fill |
| **IMPORTANT** | Orange | Orange | Orange pill | Orange tint bg | Orange stroke/fill |
| **STANDARD** | Blue | Blue | Blue pill | Blue tint bg | Blue stroke/fill |

### Features:
- **Section headers** in each category's color with letter-spacing
- **Icon circles** use the category color (stronger when selected)
- **Category badges** are color-matched capsules (e.g. red "Critical", orange "Important")
- **Select buttons** show `+` (outline) or `✓` (filled) in the category color
- **Row background** tints to the category color when a sound is selected
- **Search bar** filters across all categories live
- Selection is **persisted** to UserDefaults via `@AppStorage`
